[A10] PRE-IMPLEMENTATION CONTRACT CORRECTION / DECISION (2026-09-22)

AC5 said the entire docs-check job stays green after adding `|| true` to its Python idiom step. At live dev b17580b91deb11f3441dfc5d7f9fafe539d929b8, docs.yml runs the mandatory `ci_events.py --check` in the same job after that step; rtl.yml runs the same checker independently in full-ci-gate. AC1 therefore requires both contract steps to refuse that same mutation. Keeping docs-check green would contradict the fail-closed policy and require another bypass outside this issue's scope.

Under the maintainer's instruction to make pragmatic decisions and record them, AC5 is corrected BEFORE implementation: the tampered Python idiom STEP stays green, both contract steps reject the tree naming that step, the complete docs-check job fails, and both exhaustive aggregates fail closed. The original wording was: "while `docs-check` itself stays green". This correction strengthens the required rejection and changes no gate behavior or normative requirement. No acceptance criterion has been relaxed.

#406 is closed, no overlapping PR is open, and no design choice remains. Roles: A155 author, R219 cleared-context internal reviewer, R220 cleared-context external Opus reviewer. All five lenses, two independent positive reviews, native/local-replica/hosted validation and candidate/post-merge checks remain required. Standing automatic merge authorization applies once that complete bar is satisfied.

[A155] TAKEN
Branch: `407-carrier-script-pins` at `b17580b91deb11f3441dfc5d7f9fafe539d929b8`.
Authoritative references: current #407 body and pre-implementation AC5 decision; CONTRIBUTING.md section 3; REQUIREMENTS.md section 8; AGENTS.md; docs/README.md; docs/testing/CI_WORKFLOWS.md items 1, 2, 4, 11, 12 and the act trust boundary.
Interpreted scope: record canonical normalized scripts for every recognized run step in the four non-RTL required-context carriers, retaining specialized gates and sequence protections. Add reason-pinned mutation and vacuity controls under `carrier-script-407`, and document the maintenance cost/remedy. Workflow gate behavior and the seven RTL jobs remain outside this change.
Validation plan: ci_events --check/--selftest; docs_check, gen_toc --check, check_doc_paths; relevant Python idiom and scope helper checks; lint/xvlog checks with normal pinned submodules, build parallelism at most 8. Prepare an isolated, uncredentialed real-act AC5 experiment for manager execution; record unrun manager-owned full RTL, publication, replica, hosted, and review work separately.
Blockers: none. Required submodules now match their normal gitlinks. Manager owns push/PR/reviews and measured AC5 receipts.

[A155] IMPLEMENTATION DECISIONS

Canonical normalized bodies are recorded directly in `CARRIER_STEP_LISTS`, beside each step identity. Existing gate/setup/environment-writer constants are reused; specialized gates and sequence/key/binding checks remain active. A missing canonical body is itself a named refusal. The four workflows are unchanged.

The live carriers contain 56 run bodies (docs-check 41, wire-accountability 2, docs-check-no-git 1, elaborate 12). New `carrier-script-407` arms derive from those live steps, independently of the canonical records: replacement, appended `|| true`, and continue-on-error for every body; command removal for multi-command bodies; flag removal wherever a --selftest/--self-test/--check flag exists. A body with no such flag, including the no-git body and docs builder call, gets no fabricated flag-removal claim. Existing specialized arms remain intact. Record-removal controls and positive whitespace/record-update controls cover maintenance.

AC5 will use execution-only copies of the complete docs-check and exhaustive workflows outside `.github/workflows`, with a job-local injection of the single Python-idiom `|| true` mutation. The docs probe also plants a bare-except finding immediately before the idiom step, so its green result proves swallowing a real finding. Original gate scripts, job conditions, needs, and aggregate/verifier bodies remain in the execution copies; the checker reads the candidate workflow tree with only the intended docs script mutation. Manager will execute and publish real-act receipts using trusted orchestration and disposable uncredentialed boundaries. No real-act AC5 result is claimed here.

[A10] REVISION TAKEOVER / ASSIGNMENT

A158 has finished issue440 successfully. The sole author slot now goes to A159 (Codex) for PR505, starting from clean6af65a151663e1301f1983a6c9d22650a0b35da9 on407-carrier-script-pins. R219 internal Codex and R220 external Opus remain the independent cold re-reviewers after revision and validation. Issue407 returns to In progress; PR505 stays draft.

Accepted revision scope and validation are public in PR505 comment5771705480: resolve the duplicated Docs F1 and the Tests/Conformance F2, add the related regression controls and accurate coverage/maintenance wording, preserve production comparator/workflow semantics and every existing specialized arm. No acceptance change, defect deferral, RTL or product behavior change. A159 posts TAKEN and leaves a clean committed handoff; manager owns push, trusted act-first replication, complete validation and review scheduling. DonorPR96 is the sole active review round and does not share files.
